structuralFindings.claim: Strand E (eye-tracking, 8 units) is completely isolated: zero textual citations in either direction.
Strand D (EEG, 7 units) has exactly one outgoing textual citation (bor-sec-29 -> bor-sec-21, adopting Raffaelli's TUT terminology) and zero incoming.
Strand B (education, 5 units) is completely isolated -- the units nearest Part III's own topic cite nobody here and are cited by nobody here.
Nothing anywhere in the cluster cites Strand D or Strand E. The measurement literature is invisible to the rest of the cluster.

The A->C link (8 textual) is the ONLY phenomenology<->psychology bridge, and 7 of the 8 are Elpidorou citing Elpidorou. The 8th (bor-sec-08 -> bor-sec-25, Hughes) is a critique. Remove Elpidorou and the two literatures have exactly one connection -- an objection.

methodologicalCaveat: cites-cluster-author edges were recorded when a unit's builder found a real citation, and builders were prompted to look for siblings. Absence is mostly verified rather than merely unrecorded -- several builders documented negative checks explicitly (bor-sec-43 checked ~33 first-authors against every other unit, zero overlap; bor-sec-39 checked for Charoenpit and Jaques, found neither; bor-sec-32 confirmed Yakobi cites a DIFFERENT Elpidorou paper, 'Is Boredom One or Many?' (2020), not the regulatory papers). Still, a citation nobody looked for would not appear. The strand-matrix zeros for B and E are strong but not exhaustive proof of absence; the POSITIVE findings are direct textual evidence and do not depend on this caveat.
